item.title: Tln: Why a New Language?
item.description: The world moves faster than it did in 1995. Prolog gave us a beautiful way to reason over facts, but it was built for a world without LLMs, without live data feeds, without MCP. Tln is a modern reimagining of the expert-system language – deterministic, testable, data-native, and built to sit next to a language model rather than pretend one doesn’t exist.
